premeasurement_amendment.reason: The first lock mistakenly targeted the separate Cpp/eduPIC.cpp implementation although the production checkpoint and all prior native reference results use C/eduPIC.cc. Its incompatible integer checkpoint reader interpreted the double-scalar electron-count field as 1084520448 and was OOM-killed before particle loading or measurement began.
premeasurement_amendment.corrective_action: Instrument the exact pinned C/eduPIC.cc source, verify its native double-scalar checkpoint header under a 256 MiB address-space cap, and retain that cap for every run.

comparison.density_normalization: Divide AuroraPIC flux by its independently measured AuroraPIC/eduPIC volume-phase electron-density ratio before forming the normalized ratio.

prospective_hypothesis.statement: After density normalization, AuroraPIC has materially larger exceptional-window outward electron-energy transport than native eduPIC in total or in the above-15.8-eV tail, consistent with transport contributing to AuroraPIC's lower retained ionizing tail.
prospective_hypothesis.decision: Supported when either same-sign density-normalized AuroraPIC/eduPIC ratio reaches its corresponding threshold; otherwise not supported. Measurement validity is assessed separately.

claim_boundary: This is a local, source-instrumented cross-code comparison from one well-equilibrated checkpoint produced by eduPIC's C implementation and a constrained AuroraPIC microstate ensemble under the same nominal CCP case. The passive crossing diagnostic uses the same drift-crossing convention and histogram grid, but the continuation ensembles are not paired random streams. It is not direct comparison to a published crossing spectrum, experiment, unrestricted uncertainty quantification, or proof of general PIC correctness. The GPL-derived eduPIC source and binary remain local and are not redistributed.
